fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: # Bombay HC Condones 113-Day Delay in Form 10B Filing Amid COVID. Read full article →taxguru.in. ### Summary. * The Bombay High Court has condoned a 113-day delay in the filing of Form 10B due to COVID-19-related challenges. * The Court observed that the delay in e-verification was supported by bona fide reasons, emphasizing the impact of the pandemic. * It ruled that denying exemption on technical grounds would result in genuine hardship for the affected parties. * This decision highlights the judiciary's recognition of extraordinary circumstances affecting compliance during the pandemic. fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: The Bombay high court recently came to the rescue of an assistant teacher, a widow with a 12-year-old daughter. Justice Anoop Mohta condoned a delay of over two years in an appeal filed by Biner Dattatraya and directed the Presiding Officer to hear her plea to continue as teacher, on merits, within six months. MUMBAI: The Bombay high court recently came to the rescue of an assistant teacher, a widow with a 12-year-old daughter. To earn a living she took up a job as a teacher elsewhere but ultimately with no official reply, she filed an appeal with an application for condonation for dealy.
